test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3500

Rate (R) = 7% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{3500 times 7 times 3}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{73500}{100}

⇒ SI = 735

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
